answer: The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Each submission hangs on the wander of a task receipt, and the garden is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ember of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
